segments.text: Gummy stands on the beach, gazing out at the deep blue sea.
But even under a cloudy sky, the sea still looks blue.
Water absorbs each color of light differently.
Red light gets absorbed quickly and fades away.
Blue light isn't absorbed as easily, so it stays.
That blue light scatters back out in every direction.
The sea looks blue because of the water itself, not the sky.
